task: Explain to a ten-year-old why the moon has phases, then check the text for mistakes.

en.title: Cost: the strongest model on every step
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
Three steps, all on Strong.

**What it teaches**

The strongest model on every step is the most expensive; most of these steps would do well on a lighter model.
